description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“NamaStay,” where luxury meets Seacrest West vibes. Start your day by your private pool or unwind by the gas fire pit under the stars later on. Grill in the generous outdoor kitchen while the kids play in the spacious fenced yard. Stroll 7 minutes to the beach or explore 30A on 7 provided bikes. With 5 luxurious suites, “NamaStay” sleeps 12 comfortably. It’s more than a trip—it’s a getaway that NamaStays with you. Ready to experience it? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Seasonally Heated Pool: Relax in style by a gorgeously designed pool, surrounded by a fenced yard for ultimate privacy and tranquility.Short Walk to Beach: Enjoy a refreshing 7-minute stroll or bike ride to the pristine Gulf sands, perfect for soaking up the sun.Outdoor Entertaining: Dine and unwind in a beautifully crafted outdoor space, featuring a gas fire pit, a sleek outdoor kitchen with a Big Green Egg, a gas grill, and a spacious backyard dining area.5 Bicycles Included: Explore the picturesque 30A community on stylish bikes provided for your stay.Luxurious Space: Immerse yourself in thoughtfully designed luxury—5 beautiful bedrooms, each with its own en-suite, plus a kid-friendly bunk room with a private balcony.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The pool was heated so well that steam rose off the water! Perfect family setup, and the beach was so close." – Andrew K.⭐ "Awesome house with a great pool, fire pit, and outdoor kitchen — plus comfy beds and easy beach access. We’ll be back!" – Jamison H.⭐ "Spacious first-floor primary suite and a glorious private pool — we were thrilled with our stay!" – Nancy R.*** LIVING AREAS ***Enter a spacious, open-concept home that exudes exquisite design and style, thoughtfully crafted for both comfort and entertaining. The first-floor living area features a luxurious plush sectional sofa, a sleek large flat-screen TV, and breathtaking views of the backyard, framed by elegant French doors that enhance the effortless indoor-outdoor living experience. Every detail in this space speaks of sophistication, from the refined finishes to the seamless flow into the adjacent dining and kitchen areas, where modern elegance meets practicality.Spacious open-concept layout with stylish, versatile seating arrangementsLarge flat-screen smart TV for ultimate entertainment in a chic settingSliding French doors opening to a serene private backyard with stunning design elements*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The kitchen at "NamaStay" is a culinary haven, designed to delight any chef. Featuring a spacious center island, sleek stainless steel appliances, a gas stove, and a fully equipped wet bar, it seamlessly transitions from morning coffee rituals to evening cocktail hours. The adjoining dining area comfortably seats up to 6, making it an ideal space for shared meals and gatherings.Spacious, oversized island with seating for up to 5Equipped with a gas stove, ice maker, and sleek stainless steel appliancesElegant wet bar featuring a mini fridge and sinkDining table indoors that seats 6Additional dining table on the outdoor porch that also seats 6*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Relax and entertain in your own private backyard oasis. Fire up the grill for a barbecue, gather around the fire pit to roast marshmallows, or lounge by the pool while the kids enjoy the fun-filled outdoor play area.Private seasonally heated (Sep-Apr) pool with plenty of poolside seating and sun loungersFully fenced yard for ultimate seclusion and peace of mindCozy gas fire pit, perfect for stargazing on cool eveningsGorgeous covered outdoor kitchen featuring a Big Green Egg and a gas grillCovered outdoor dining area with smart TV for effortless entertaining*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary Suite: King-size bed, views of the pool, en-suite with soaking tub, double vanities, and walk-in shower.Half bathroom conveniently located on this floor.2nd Floor:Primary Suite: King-size bed with en-suite featuring double vanities and glass-enclosed shower.Front Queen Guest Room: Queen bed with en-suite featuring single vanity and glass-enclosed shower.Rear Queen Guest Room: Queen bed with en-suite featuring single vanity and tub/shower combo.3rd Floor:Bunk Room: Custom-built bunk beds with a Queen-over-Queen setup (Sleeps 4), private balcony, and en-suite with glass-enclosed shower.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest Beach West, NamaStay provides convenient access to some of 30A’s most iconic destinations. Take an 8-minute stroll to Alys Beach or enjoy a short 6-minute drive to the charming Rosemary Beach. Spend your days browsing local boutiques, soaking in live music at “The Big Chill,” or simply relaxing along the breathtaking coastline.Alys Beach - An 8-minute bike ride will take you to this picturesque spot, known for its stunning white architecture and serene, upscale vibe.Seacrest Beach - Only a 10-minute bike ride, this laid-back beach offers a peaceful escape with soft sands and calm waters, perfect for relaxation.The Big Chill - Just a 5-minute drive away, this lively hub is perfect for grabbing a bite, listening to live music, and soaking in the vibrant community atmosphere.Rosemary Beach - A short 6-minute drive, this charming town combines European-style streets with a cozy, upscale coastal vibe, ideal for exploring shops and cafes.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Pool is heated from September 1 to April 30.Waiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 102688STRO #: STR-102688
